free_tier.stated: The tracker lists EUR 3.99 per month for 1 Epyc core, 2,048 MB RAM, 32 GB NVMe, 3,000 GB a month on a 10 Gbps port, in Austria and Germany. That plan is not on the vendor's own pages read the same day: the Linux VPS page sells a Ryzen line whose cheapest tier is 'Small VPS' at EUR 4.99 per month with 1 core, 2 GB RAM, 25 GB NVMe and a '10Gbit Uplink - 5TB/m' network line, deployable in Germany, Austria, Netherlands, London, Salt Lake City and New York. The next tiers are Medium at EUR 15.99 (2 cores, 4 GB, 50 GB, 7 TB/m) and Large at EUR 29.99 (4 cores, 8 GB, 100 GB, 10 TB/m). No Epyc tier and no EUR 3.99 tier appears on the site.
